evaluation_unit: one replicate mean over the configured number of tasks
interval_method: two-sided 95% t interval across replicate-level values

metric_definitions.clarification_frequency: clarification requests divided by all generated tasks
metric_definitions.expected_total_cost: mean total cost per generated task
metric_definitions.incorrect_action_rate: incorrect unclarified actions divided by all generated tasks
metric_definitions.task_success_rate: successful outcomes divided by all generated tasks

pairing: policies share tasks within each replicate
